newsitem.title: CHINA: China Supreme Court to focus on financial fraud.
newsitem.headline: China Supreme Court to focus on financial fraud.

text.p: China's highest court, the People's Supreme Court, will focus its efforts in 1997 on cracking down on financial fraud, the China Securities newspaper said on Wednesday.

Criminal cases involving shares, bonds and commercial paper leapt 87.81 percent in 1996 over 1995, the court said in a report to the National People's Congress, or parliament, which was quoted by the newspaper.
Contract disputes rose 32.06 percent in 1996 compared to 1995, a figure the court said was evidence that financial irregulaties were a serious problem in China.
